name: Footer-doormat-lockup
purpose: The full mega-footer arrangement: the gated/proposed Footer organism's doormat form, composed 100% verbatim and shown as end-of-page matter with a content stub above it, so the doormat is seen where it actually lives rather than as an isolated component demo. Wave-6 itinerary row 121 (Layer 2, class NO-ARTEFACT-CLASS at mint; PROPOSED here, not ruled).
$vocabularyNote: Inherits Footer's own s202-D3 vocabulary-collision declaration verbatim: 'footer' already means a container's action row (Drawer/Modals/Data-grid/Action-bar) elsewhere in this repo. This lock-up composes the OTHER footer — Footer's own site-footer/doormat form. See footer.meta.json's $vocabularyCollision for the full statement; nothing here renames anything, and renaming stays Dave's.

props.name: form
props.$note: This lock-up composes ONLY Footer's doormat form (the brief names it 'the full mega-footer arrangement' explicitly). Footer's own `slim` form is out of scope here — a slim legal-only bar is not a mega-footer and does not need its own lock-up.

props.name: groups
props.$note: Inherited from Footer, unmodified: each group is a <nav> with aria-labelledby pointing at its own heading. The specimen shows 4 groups.

variants.name: doormat
variants.use: The end of a marketing or servicing page — the reader may still be looking for something. The ONLY variant this lock-up draws.

tokens.$note: Every token is Footer's own, re-declared verbatim by name (see footer.meta.json `tokens` for the full list: page/surface/divider/subdivider/text/muted/icon/focus/border-radius-control/target-min). This lock-up binds nothing new beyond `.fdl-*`, which is page-context layout only — no colour, no type-size, no radius declaration of its own.

$placeholderHrefs: ⛔ CARRIED, NOT REPAIRED (brief DO-NOT-RULE, explicit). Every link href in this file is Footer's own known open item, copied unchanged — repairing them here would be re-drawing a decision that belongs to Footer's own build, not this lock-up's.
$44pxFinding: Inherited unchanged from Footer: every footer link is a >= 44px target at every width (see footer.meta.json `$finding-44px-cost`). This lock-up does not re-measure it independently — it is Footer's own finding, carried.

responsive.$status: PROPOSED at #210 wave-6 (not ruled) — reflow verified in a real browser at 3 widths.
responsive.rule: Identical to Footer's own doormat rule (container <=560px: mat collapses to one column, legal bar stacks) — untouched. The NEW check this lock-up adds is NON-OVERLAP: the `.fdl-content` stub and the `.ft` footer never overlap at any width, driven and measured (lesson 7's non-sticky analogue — a static footer has no overlay to prove, so the proof here is that ordinary document flow keeps the two regions apart).

accessibility.landmark: <footer role="contentinfo"> aria-label="Site footer", inherited unchanged from Footer.
accessibility.colourIsNeverAlone: No RAG value appears anywhere in this component, inherited from Footer.

antiPatterns: Repairing Footer's placeholder hrefs from inside this lock-up — that belongs to Footer's own build
Re-drawing any `.ft-*` rule instead of composing Footer verbatim — the #202 defect class the brief names explicitly
Giving the content stub the same visual weight as a real page — it is demo chrome only, deletable without changing the footer

tokenValidation.against: Footer.reference.html's own token manifest, re-declared verbatim by name here
